Title: Public preview: Azure Search Blob indexer parses structured JSON content

Body.Content: Azure Search indexers for Blob storage were announced in March with the ability to crack open and index major document formats, including PDF, Microsoft Office, HTML, JSON, and more. The Blob storage indexer can now parse JSON blobs and select any part of the JSON payload for indexing in Azure Search. Currently, this functionality is in preview. It is available only in the REST API version 2015-02-28-Preview. Read this article to learn more!
